title: Finding the Needle in a Haystack: Test-Time Analog Circuit Representation Adaptation for Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.12687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a sample-efficient framework for analog circuit topology search, where evaluating each candidate topology can require costly simulation. However, representation-based BO methods typically treat circuit embeddings as fixed after encoder training. This creates a mismatch between representation learning and optimization: embeddings learned to encode or reconstruct circuit structure are not necessarily organized according to the figure of merit (FoM) being optimized. This paper introduces Test-Time Analog Representation Adaptation for Bayesian Optimization (TTARO), an online deep-kernel BO framework that adapts circuit representations throughout the search process. Starting from pretrained circuit embeddings, TTARO jointly learns a nonlinear feature transformation and a Gaussian-process surrogate using the FoM labels of the circuits evaluated so far. translated_title: 在干草堆中寻找针尖：贝叶斯优化中的测试时模拟电路表示自适应
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）是一种用于模拟电路拓扑搜索的样本高效框架，其中评估每个候选拓扑可能需要昂贵的仿真。然而，基于表示的BO方法通常在编码器训练后将电路嵌入视为固定不变。这造成了表示学习与优化之间的不匹配：用于编码或重构电路结构的嵌入，并不一定按照正在优化的性能指标（FoM）来组织。本文介绍了测试时模拟表示自适应用于贝叶斯优化（TTARO），这是一种在线深度核BO框架，在搜索过程中自适应电路表示。从预训练的电路嵌入开始，TTARO使用迄今评估的电路的FoM标签，联合学习非线性特征变换和高斯过程代理模型。在每次新评估后，TTARO更新表示。
tldr: 本文提出了TTARO框架，通过在线自适应电路表示，使贝叶斯优化中的嵌入与性能指标对齐，从而提升模拟电路拓扑搜索的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TTARO, a framework that adapts circuit representations online during Bayesian optimization to align embeddings with the figure of merit, improving analog circuit topology search efficiency.
